entries.value_on_disk: Outside every known reduction to E0: any isogeny to levels 1/263 has degree divisible by p ~ 2^57 (Kohel96 Prop 21-22, JMV05 Thm 2.1(5), Gal99 Prop 1); p is not polylog(q) so JMV05 Cor 1.2 does not bridge it (JMV05 sec. 6 names exactly this situation for Koblitz CM classes). Bridged to level 263p by 263-isogenies (polynomial time). Best known attack: rho with negation only.
